ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon dead-drop C2 resolution via Telegram / Telegraph / Cloudflare workers from a LOLBin
ucs.description: Hunts LOLBins (powershell, wscript, mshta, rundll32, regsvr32) reaching Gamaredon's signature dead-drop resolvers — Telegram channels, telegra.ph posts, Cloudflare workers/trycloudflare tunnels, ipinfo.io and pastebin — that the GammaLoad / PowerMagic / GammaSteel stagers use to fetch the live C2 IP. This pairing of FSU-attributed LOLBin chain → public web service for C2 lookup is the bread-and-butter Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm tradecraft, distinct from generic Cobalt Strike-style direct C2.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as url values(Web.http_user_agent) as ua from datamodel=Web.Web where (Web.url="*telegra.ph*" OR Web.url="*t.me/*" OR Web.url="*telegram.org*" OR Web.url="*workers.dev*" OR Web.url="*trycloudflare.com*" OR Web.url="*pastebin.com*" OR Web.url="*ipinfo.io*" OR Web.url="*cdn.discordapp.com*") by Web.src Web.user Web.dest host
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as proc_cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=powershell.exe OR Processes.process_name=pwsh.exe OR Processes.process_name=wscript.exe OR Processes.process_name=cscript.exe OR Processes.process_name=mshta.exe OR Processes.process_name=rundll32.exe OR Processes.process_name=regsvr32.exe) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
    | rename dest as src process_name as lolbin
  ]
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime src user lolbin proc_cmdline parent url ua count
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let DeadDrops = dynamic(["telegra.ph","t.me","telegram.org","workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","pastebin.com","ipinfo.io","cdn.discordapp.com","raw.githubusercontent.com"]);
let LolBins = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","hh.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LolBins)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where RemoteUrl has_any (DeadDrops)
| extend MatchedDeadDrop = tostring(extract(@"(?i)(telegra\.ph|t\.me|telegram\.org|workers\.dev|trycloudflare\.com|pastebin\.com|ipinfo\.io|cdn\.discordapp\.com|raw\.githubusercontent\.com)", 1, tostring(RemoteUrl)))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          LolBin=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ProcCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage=InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, MatchedDeadDrop, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let DeadDrops = dynamic(["telegra.ph","t.me","telegram.org","workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","pastebin.com","ipinfo.io","cdn.discordapp.com","raw.githubusercontent.com"]);
let LolbinProcs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
ImDnsActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where DnsQuery has_any (DeadDrops)
| join kind=inner LolbinProcs on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + WindowMinutes)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, DnsQuery, SrcIpAddr
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon LitterDrifter USB worm — wscript executing VBS from removable drive + LNK seeding
ucs.description: Hunts the propagation primitive of Gamaredon's LitterDrifter USB worm: wscript.exe (often spawned by explorer.exe when a user double-clicks a fake folder LNK) executing a VBS payload whose path resolves to a removable drive letter, correlated with LNK shortcut creation on the root of that same drive and/or the trash.dll / jersey.dll loader names. This chain is documented by Check Point and Symantec as Shuckworm/Aqua Blizzard's late-2023+ Ukraine intrusion vector.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=wscript.exe AND (Processes.process="*trash.dll*" OR Processes.process="*jersey.dll*" OR Processes.process="*D:\\*.vbs" OR Processes.process="*E:\\*.vbs" OR Processes.process="*F:\\*.vbs" OR Processes.process="*G:\\*.vbs" OR Processes.process="*H:\\*.vbs") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| join type=left dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Filesystem.file_path) as lnk_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk" AND (Filesystem.file_path="D:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="E:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="F:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="G:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="H:\\*") by Filesystem.dest
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
  ]
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user cmdline parent lnk_paths count
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let UsbDriveRe = @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.vbs";
let LitterArtifacts = dynamic(["trash.dll","jersey.dll","Jersey.lnk","Trash.lnk","Bird.lnk"]);
let WscriptFromUsb = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "wscript.exe"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex UsbDriveRe
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (LitterArtifacts)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ProcCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              GrandParent=InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
let UsbLnkWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName endswith ".lnk"
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\"
    | project LnkTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, LnkFile=FileName, LnkFolder=FolderPath,
              LnkWriter=InitiatingProcessFileName;
WscriptFromUsb
| join kind=leftouter UsbLnkWrites on DeviceId
| where isnotempty(LnkFile) or ProcCmd has_any (LitterArtifacts) or ProcCmd matches regex UsbDriveRe
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcCmd, ParentImage, ParentCmd, GrandParent, LnkFile, LnkFolder, LnkWriter, LnkTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let UsbDriveRe = @"(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.vbs";
let LitterArtifacts = dynamic(["trash.dll","jersey.dll","Jersey.lnk","Trash.lnk","Bird.lnk"]);
let WscriptFromUsb = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActingProcessName has "wscript.exe"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex UsbDriveRe

    | where TargetFileName endswith ".lnk"

WscriptFromUsb
| join kind=leftouter UsbLnkWrites on DvcHostname
| where isnotempty(LnkFile) or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (LitterArtifacts) or ActingProcessCommandLine matches regex UsbDriveRe
| project TimeGenerated=ProcTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, LnkFile, LnkPath, LnkTime
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Gamaredon LitterDrifter USB Worm - wscript Executing VBS from Removable Drive
id: 8b4d0a7f-5d68-4cde-aa99-gamaredon-litter
status: experimental
description: Detects wscript.exe executing a VBScript file referenced on a removable drive (drive letters D: through Z:) or invoking Gamaredon LitterDrifter loader artefacts (trash.dll, jersey.dll, Jersey.lnk). This is the USB-replication signature of Gamaredon (Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm / Primitive Bear).
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2023/malware-spotlight-into-the-trash-analyzing-litterdrifter/
  - https://symantec-enterprise-blogs.security.com/threat-intelligence/shuckworm-ukraine-gamaredon
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.lateral_movement
  - attack.t1091
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.g0047
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\wscript.exe'
  selection_usb_vbs:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\b[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.vbs'
  selection_loader_artifact:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'trash.dll'
      - 'jersey.dll'
      - 'Jersey.lnk'
      - 'Trash.lnk'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and (selection_usb_vbs or selection_loader_artifact) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Bespoke enterprise USB-deployment scripts (allowlist by SHA256)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE) (@CommandLine:(*\:\\*.vbs OR *trash.dll* OR *jersey.dll* OR *Jersey.lnk* OR *Trash.lnk*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\wscript\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)([D-Z]:\\\\[^\\\\]+\\.vbs|trash\\.dll|jersey\\.dll|Jersey\\.lnk|Trash\\.lnk)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: LitterDrifter is uniquely Gamaredon — Check Point's Nov-2023 publication and Symantec's Shuckworm follow-up tie the loader (trash.dll / jersey.dll) and the LNK-seeded VBS chain on USB roots specifically to this group's Ukraine campaign. Other Russian state clusters (APT28 GooseEgg, Sandworm, Turla Snake/ComRAT) do not propagate via wscript-on-USB and do not drop the trash/jersey artefact names. Fi
